method_note: Full-suite pytest trust was not assumed from a single monolithic invocation, per the disclosed pre-fit outer-harness timeout-annotation ambiguity (see prefit_regression_disclosure.json). Instead: (1) collect-only enumerated every test node deterministically, (2) the sorted node list was hashed, (3) the node list was partitioned into fixed-size deterministic chunks, (4) every chunk was executed as its own pytest invocation well under any outer tool timeout, (5) executed == collected was proven exactly. Collection/chunking was run twice: once before tests/test_c_v2_006_audit_closeout.py existed (1607 nodes, PASS) and once after it was added (1622 nodes, PASS) -- the second run is authoritative for the committed state.

chunking.hash_method_note: Computed by scripts/run_v2_006_closeout_chunked_regression.py as sha256('\n'.join(sorted(nodes))) with no trailing newline.
